events.summary: Requested restoring URL-key authentication for ChatGPT while retaining Claude header authentication.

Reported deployment and verification of v2.0.3, with ChatGPT URL-key route restricted to OpenAI connector IP ranges and Claude header route retained. Source diff corroborates the implementation; this historical test report was not rerun during recovery.

Reported use of three eBay tools with 17 searches and five deep inspections and no failures. Suggested total_cost, functional_status, listing_warnings, shipping/collection restrictions, pagination, and preserving recent negative feedback. These are proposals/test reports, not evidence that the proposed features were implemented.
